supersession_reason: The second independent review confirmed that its registry entry and certificate retained an overbroad in-grid label. This version makes all public metadata describe a fixed complete parameter label with physically projected candidate-scale pre-projection perturbations; frozen candidates, seeds, methods, arrays and decision rules remain unchanged.
purpose: Determine whether the complete nine-filter joint method adds state-estimation or one-, three-, and seven-day forecast value when the true complete parameter label is fixed and the pre-projection process perturbation scale is exactly one of the frozen three-by-three candidates.
matched_design: Within each independent block, all nine fixed truth labels share meteorological forcing, standard-normal pre-projection process draws and standard-normal observation draws. The frozen complete parameter vector and covariance used to scale the pre-projection draw differ by truth label; physical projection may then truncate the realized draw.

forcing.angle_formula: linearly spaced from 0 through 2*pi, including both endpoints

truth_rule: Each truth starts from an independently warmed state for its complete parameter vector. Every active day uses the independent authoritative one-day simulator, adds a diagonal Gaussian draw scaled by the fixed candidate covariance before projection, applies the independent physical projection and computes routed discharge independently. The post-projection distribution is physically constrained and is not an exact additive Gaussian filter model.
methods: trained-center single filter with the frozen selected process covariance
three-parameter filter bank with the selected process covariance
three-process-covariance filter bank with the trained-center parameter vector

decision_rules.effective_against_fixed_filter: Both the global root mean square error improvement is at least five percent and the 95 percent matched-block bootstrap upper bound for joint minus fixed-filter block root mean square error is below zero.
decision_rules.added_value_beyond_single_factor_methods: The effective-against-fixed-filter rule holds and the matched-block bootstrap upper bounds for joint minus both parameter-only and process-noise-only methods are below zero.

resource_pilot.purpose: task-scale runtime and resident-memory feasibility only; its seed and outputs are excluded from scientific decisions

scope_limit: This favorable-condition experiment determines fixed-label joint-method identification, origin-state error and one-, three-, and seven-day forecast error relative to fair controls under physically projected candidate-scale truth. It does not establish exact additive Gaussian process-model recovery or behavior under switching truth, weak observations, shorter assimilation, forcing error or real basins; those are separate failure-boundary questions.
